clusters.headline: Sugiono and Andi Amran Sulaiman Undergo Health Checks at RSPAD
aiSummaryBullets: Candidates Sugiono and Andi Amran Sulaiman are attending medical examinations at RSPAD for their vice presidential candidacy.
The MPR verification team confirmed that both candidates have cleared corruption and LHKPN background checks conducted via the KPK.

clusters.headline: Three Miners Dead, Twenty-Three Missing in Bogor Illegal Gold Mine
aiSummaryBullets: Three miners were confirmed dead after being trapped in a flooding incident at an illegal gold mine in Gunung Butak, Bogor.
Search and rescue teams continue to look for 23 additional workers believed to remain inside the complex network of deep mine shafts.

clusters.headline: MPR Schedules Vice President Election For December 10 And 11, 2026
aiSummaryBullets: The MPR Ad Hoc Committee proposed a two-day plenary session on December 10 and 11, 2026, to select a successor for the vacant Vice Presidency.
Verification teams are currently vetting two vice-presidential candidates by coordinating with the KPK, Supreme Court, Police, and Ministry of Finance.

clusters.headline: Polri Postpones Irjen Slamet Uliandi Ethics Trial Due To Health
aiSummaryBullets: The Indonesian National Police (Polri) officially postponed the professional ethics trial for Irjen Slamet Uliandi.
Officials cited the former Head of the Information and Communication Technology Division's ongoing hospitalization as the reason for the delay.

clusters.headline: Sufmi Dasco Denies Vice President Bid Amid Prabowo Nomination Talk
aiSummaryBullets: Sufmi Dasco clarified he is not seeking the vice presidential role and was asked by President Prabowo Subianto to recommend two candidates instead.
Candidates Andi Amran Sulaiman and Sugiono remain under public and official scrutiny, including tax compliance reviews, as potential successors.

clusters.headline: BMKG Projects Rain Throughout Indonesia Amid Ongoing Weather Risks
aiSummaryBullets: The BMKG forecasts light rain across the majority of Indonesian regions on Wednesday.
The Jabodetabek area is expected to experience light rainfall according to current meteorological projections.

clusters.headline: Jaksa Siapkan 142 Saksi dalam Sidang Korupsi Tambang Rp 17,7 Triliun
aiSummaryBullets: Jaksa telah mempersiapkan 142 saksi untuk memberikan keterangan dalam kasus korupsi pertambangan.
Kasus ini berkaitan dengan dugaan kerugian negara yang mencapai Rp 17,7 triliun.

clusters.headline: Mendagri Tito Karnavian Minta Kepala Daerah Perkuat Koordinasi
aiSummaryBullets: Mendagri Tito Karnavian menginstruksikan kepala daerah mengoptimalkan Forkopimda untuk langkah antisipasi bencana.
Pemetaan risiko bencana yang matang ditekankan sebagai syarat utama dalam menjaga kesiapan di tingkat daerah.

clusters.headline: Polda NTT Questions Kupang Regent Yosef Lede In Assault Probe
aiSummaryBullets: Kupang Regent Yosef Lede has undergone questioning by police regarding ongoing allegations of sexual assault.
Police previously conducted a search of the regent's official residence, seizing several items as potential evidence for the investigation.

clusters.headline: Kasus Dugaan Pemerkosaan, Polda NTT Geledah Rumah Dinas Bupati Kupang
aiSummaryBullets: CNN Indonesia reports: Kasus Dugaan Pemerkosaan, Polda NTT Geledah Rumah Dinas Bupati Kupang
Okezone reports: Direktur PPA-PPO Polda NTT Kombes Nova Irone Digeser di Tengah Kasus Dugaan Pemerkosaan Bupati Kupang

clusters.headline: DVI Teams Identify Remains Following Massive Fire At PT FAM Cikande
aiSummaryBullets: Police forensic teams are accelerating DNA testing to identify remains recovered from the site of the factory fire.
Search efforts for dozens of missing individuals have been hindered by unstable building structures and adverse weather conditions.

clusters.headline: Selasa, layanan SIM keliling tersedia di lima lokasi Jakarta
aiSummaryBullets: Antara reports: Selasa, layanan SIM keliling tersedia di lima lokasi Jakarta
VIVA reports: Cek Lokasi SIM Keliling Jakarta, Bogor, Bekasi, dan Bandung 18 November

clusters.headline: Prabowo Seeks 70% Mining Revenue Share As He Hails New Chief Suyudi
aiSummaryBullets: President Prabowo Subianto plans to secure 70% of mining revenues for national use to fund infrastructure like schools and water facilities.
The administration is currently developing regulatory schemes to implement this revenue redistribution, receiving support from the Wantimpres.

clusters.headline: Bekasi Mayor Tri Adhianto Questioned Over 2 Trillion IDR Gas Fraud
aiSummaryBullets: The Attorney General's Office is investigating allegations of corruption involving an oil and gas operational cooperation between local firms and Pertamina EP.
Bekasi Mayor Tri Adhianto was summoned and questioned as a witness regarding the procedures used in the management of the operational contract.

clusters.headline: Regional Governments and Officials Target Indonesia Economic Growth
aiSummaryBullets: The Ministry of Home Affairs identified four core components essential for sustaining national economic momentum.
Regional administrations, including Jayapura, Central Java, and East Java, are launching local initiatives to stimulate economic development.

clusters.headline: Persib Bandung Prepares To Face FC Seoul In AFC Champions League 2
aiSummaryBullets: Persib Bandung is preparing for their upcoming AFC Champions League 2 match against FC Seoul.
The club is currently evaluating scenarios to secure the top position in Group E.

clusters.headline: Kejaksaan Agung Tugaskan 32 Jaksa Tangani Kasus Listyo Sigit Cs
aiSummaryBullets: The Attorney General's Office has designated 32 prosecutors to oversee the legal files concerning former National Police Chief Listyo Sigit Prabowo.
Bareskrim investigators identified a civilian suspect linked to the alleged illegal wiretapping operations conducted by Listyo Sigit and his associates.

clusters.headline: Police Arrest Kampung Ambon Drug Supplier, Seizing Marijuana Cache
aiSummaryBullets: Authorities arrested a suspect identified as RA in Mandailing Natal, North Sumatra, following an investigation into Kampung Ambon drug distribution.
The suspect allegedly recruited local farmers to cultivate marijuana which was then smuggled into Jakarta.

clusters.headline: Indonesian Provinces Announce New Provincial Minimum Wage For 2027
aiSummaryBullets: Provincial governments across Indonesia are announcing 2027 minimum wage figures by the government's November 21 deadline.
West Java, Yogyakarta, and South Sulawesi have disclosed their updated wage rates as part of the nationwide policy rollout.

clusters.headline: Polri Fires AKBP Guntur Yayus Putra for Role in Alleged Treason Case
aiSummaryBullets: The Indonesian National Police (Polri) has officially dismissed AKBP Guntur Yayus Putra from duty.
The dismissal follows investigations into his alleged involvement in a treason case and the unauthorized surveillance of government officials.
